name: io.ovaculos/obsidian-cli
title: obsidian-cli
description: MCP server for Obsidian — read, write, search, and manage notes via the Obsidian CLI

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Obsidian binary (default: /Applications/Obsidian.app/Contents/MacOS/obsidian on macOS)

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Default vault name. If omitted, targets the active vault.
